brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors detected; all nine RC items met with appropriate evidence. Multiple high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO3, HO4) were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact. Closure is valid_open with family demonstrating comprehension and clear next actions. Grade 5 justified by no in-chain errors plus four completed high-order test points.
